# Chaplain
1. Your direct superior is the Head of Personnel.
2. Chaplains must regularly be in the vicinity of their chapel area, so as to provide spiritual and metaphysical guidance to the station’s crew.
3. Chaplains are to maintain the secrecy of anything they learn or discover through confessions, unless it is a threat to any of Central Command or Nanotrasen’s Command Team.
4. When requested for spiritual services, chaplains are to accompany the requester to the site of needed rituals or aid.
